mechanism_narrative: Continued recovery in WORKPLACES mobility toward baseline reduces the share of workers at home, restoring weekday commuting and lunchtime shopping trips that raise RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains above -15%, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -40.0 for two consecutive weeks signals restored public-transit commuting that brings shoppers to retail districts and lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -40.0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the last 28-day mean within two weeks after TRANSIT exceeds -40.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in RESIDENTIAL below 5% and recovery in WORKPLACES above -15% indicates a broad return to pre-pandemic routines; the combined effect increases retail footfall more than either series alone, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL < 5.0 and WORKPLACES > -15.0 jointly occur.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a PARKS drop below -25 combined with TRANSIT below -40 reflects reduced permitted out-of-home activity and depressed consumer traffic, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the last 14-day mean when PARKS < -25 and TRANSIT < -40.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal spring warming typically lifts PARKS mobility from winter lows; even a partial recovery in PARKS from its current depressed level signals more overall out-of-home activity and supports a rise in RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS rises over the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC remains below its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained PARKS level below -25 indicates suppressed discretionary out-of-home activity; because retail trips and park visits share the same discretionary mobility budget, RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28-day mean while PARKS remains below -25 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL above 5% signals elevated stay-at-home behavior that suppresses trips to retail and recreation; as long as RESIDENTIAL remains above 5%, RETAIL_REC will decline over the next one week.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the last 14-day mean while RESIDENTIAL is above 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES toward baseline reflects a synchronized return of commuting and public mobility; this reinforces retail trips and produces higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28-day mean when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve relative to t-3w.
